verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no interactive API reference with runnable examples, whether as a Docusaurus feature or for Docusaurus's own config API, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. MDX and embeddable React components are developer building blocks that could be used to build such a reference, so they earn no credit. The browser-based docusaurus.new playground is a different feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
